name: run_frame_with_key_commands
description: Runs one frame of the main loop: calls the game's routines through a function-pointer table, advances a frame counter and timers, and reads a key to set command flags for L, T, P or the asterisk key. It synchronises with graphics library waits for the video frame and blitter, and it references the text PIT STOP.

name: forward_stack_value_after_call
description: Calls one unnamed routine and then returns an 8-byte value taken from the caller's stack unchanged. It does nothing else.

name: accumulate_squared_point_distances
description: Walks consecutive coordinate triples, takes the differences between neighbouring points, and adds their squared lengths into a running total. It also stores scaled component products in two result tables and returns the total.

name: compute_scaled_cross_product
description: Builds two edge vectors from three points in three coordinate arrays, computes their cross product with a right shift, and divides each component by a scalar that defaults to one when zero. It stores the three results.

name: generate_path_points_with_clamp
description: Walks a sequence of path points, splits each segment into equal steps, and writes an interpolated coordinate triple per step. A turn value is clamped to plus or minus 90, accumulated in steps of ten, and stored as a byte beside each point.

name: compute_scaled_entry_timings
description: Derives a scale factor from a table lookup and a stored speed value, using a fixed default when that value is zero. It then writes a timing value into each record of a list, offset by a constant and never below ten, and shifts the stored scale down by two bits.

name: initialise_object_state_tables
description: Initialises a block of object state: sets a flag to minus one, clears counters, and copies table values and their negated forms into the object record. It then makes two routine calls.

name: call_then_store_minus_one
description: Calls one routine and then stores the value minus one in a fixed field of the object record. It does nothing else.

name: restore_object_state_from_saved
description: Copies saved per-object values back into the live tables and pointer fields, stores negated coordinates, makes several routine calls, and then clears a set of counters and flags.

name: return_without_action
description: A bare return with no effect. It is reached through a handler pointer held in data, so it acts as an empty hook that other code can call safely.

name: return_immediately_from_call
description: A bare return with no effect, called once from another routine. It performs no work.

name: return_empty_handler
description: A bare return with no effect, called by four other routines as an empty callback.

name: rotate_record_ring_buffer
description: Shifts a list of eight-byte records down by one place, copying the first record to the end. It works backwards from the last index, so each entry takes the value of the one after it.

name: format_labelled_time_text
description: Writes a time value into a text buffer as minutes, seconds and hundredths separated by colon and point characters. It first copies a ten-character label from a table entry into the buffer.

name: write_time_into_record_field
description: Converts a time value to minutes, seconds and hundredths and writes the digits into a display field, followed by a space and a ten-character label copied from a table. The field position comes from an index into a table of offsets.

name: draw_glyph_into_bitplanes
description: Draws one eight-row glyph into the four interleaved bitplanes of screen memory. Pixel rows come from a font table, are shifted by a computed bit offset, and are OR-ed into each plane whose mask bit is set. It does nothing when the character value is outside a fixed range.

name: set_lap_row_markers
description: Sets marker values in up to four row entries of a lap-times table, depending on how many rows the count covers, and then sets a final mode value. It references the text LAP TIMES.

name: copy_field_and_advance_counter
description: Copies one stored word into a second field and adds six to a stored counter, advancing it by a fixed step.

name: render_lap_time_rows
description: Calls several routines to draw the lap-time headings, then walks the lap count backwards and calls a routine for each row. It returns the stored average value. The text labels AVERAGE LAP and LAP TIMES are referenced.

name: format_digits_or_blank
description: Writes six display characters from stored digit values when the input is within a fixed non-negative range, and writes spaces otherwise. It calls one routine before writing.

name: copy_nine_bytes_then_call
description: Copies a nine-byte string from a source pointer into a fixed text buffer and then calls one routine.

name: format_two_digit_value_text
description: Writes a number up to 99 as two text characters, using a blank in place of a leading zero. It calls one routine and then fills four more characters from stored digit values.

name: split_time_into_digit_fields
description: Converts a time value, halved, into minutes, seconds and hundredths. Each part is stored as a single decimal digit in its own field, with minutes reduced to two digits.

name: update_elapsed_time_display
description: Returns early when a flag is set. Otherwise it computes elapsed time from a current clock value minus a stored value, writes it into digit fields as minutes, seconds and hundredths, and draws one glyph into the bitplanes.

name: return_no_operation
description: A bare return with no effect, reached through a handler pointer held in data.

name: call_routines_with_swapped_pointer
description: Temporarily replaces a pointer field in the object record with each of two fixed table addresses in turn, calling a routine after each, and then restores the original value. It runs only when one flag is set or a second flag is clear.

name: prepare_lap_count_display
description: Sets four layout fields to fixed values, then derives a count either from a stored difference or from a stored value clamped at zero. It reduces the count to two digits and calls routines to draw the tens digit when it is nonzero and to finish the text.

name: write_linked_entry_rows_text
description: Walks a linked list of up to three records, writing each record's two-character code and its index plus one as two decimal digits into a text buffer at fixed row offsets. Unused slots are then filled with spaces. The text NO. LAP is referenced.

name: set_entry_values_from_minimum
description: Finds the smallest value of a stored field across a linked list of entries, skipping one special entry. Each entry then gets either a fixed high cap or a value from a table lookup scaled by that minimum, depending on a mode field, and a routine is called at the end.

name: find_entry_and_write_row
description: Searches a linked list for the entry whose first word matches a key, returning minus one if none matches. On a match it writes the entry's position number, its code and a time value into a text row, or placeholder bytes when it has no time, and returns zero.

name: cycle_entry_row_text
description: Advances a rotating index stored in the object record and selects the list entry at that position. It writes the entry's position number, code and time, or placeholder bytes when no time exists, into a text row. The text QUALIFYING is referenced. It returns minus one when the list ends.

name: advance_selected_entry_index
description: When two flags are both clear, moves the selection index on to the next list entry with wraparound at the count, copies a field from that entry, and resets two selection fields to minus one and zero.

name: format_signed_entry_delta_text
description: When a flag is clear, writes a text row for the selected entry: a plus or minus sign, its two-character code, and a value divided by twenty shown as digits with a decimal point. It does nothing when the flag is set.

name: sort_entry_list_by_position
description: Sorts a linked list of entries into ascending order of a computed key by swapping adjacent entries until none are out of order. The key combines a stored value with a shifted component, or uses a shared value when a flag applies. It runs only when a flag is clear and the count is non-negative.

name: update_timer_and_entry_state
description: Records the current clock value into a stored field when a flag is set. Otherwise it either resets the entry count and sets a marker, recomputing a stored timer from the clock and a per-unit time, or clears the first entry's fields and adds the scaled time to the clock.

name: sort_entries_by_time_value
description: Repeatedly swaps adjacent entries in a linked list whenever the earlier entry's stored value is larger than the next one's, until a full pass makes no swap. It returns whether any swap happened.

name: advance_track_segment_position
description: Searches track segments by a weighted sum of three coordinate values compared with a per-segment threshold, and stores the new segment index when a threshold is crossed. It then handles checkpoint events such as recording times and updating position labels, calling routines to update state and display.

name: fire_transition_event_once
description: Tests a per-segment byte from a table against a value, together with two flags, and calls one routine when the condition first becomes true or false. Latch flags make the routine run only on that transition.

name: dispatch_routine_by_mode
description: Calls a routine chosen by a mode field. Mode three and any mode other than one take one path, and mode one takes another, each making a single call.

name: call_through_wrapper
description: Calls one routine and returns, doing nothing else. It is a wrapper entered through a handler pointer.

name: record_lap_and_write_codes
description: Stores the completed lap time in a lap table and adds it to a running total when the lap index is in range, setting a status bit. It then advances the lap counter and writes list entries as two-character codes into a text row. The text QUALIFYING is referenced.

name: update_progress_status_bits
description: Updates per-frame progress. Depending on a mode value it either counts frames and sets status bits once thresholds are reached, or restores position fields from table values and decrements a timer. It calls several routines and references the text PLEASE WAIT and WARNING.

name: interpolate_positions_over_steps
description: Moves the stored position toward a target over eight steps, computing each step from the difference shifted right by three. It copies a block of values on each step and stops early when a flag is set. It returns after the last step.

name: reset_or_step_position
description: Either restores the object's position from a table entry and clears its counters, or moves the position toward a target over eight steps while calling routines. The facts show it touches the four audio volume hardware registers and references the text PLEASE WAIT.

name: load_position_from_track_table
description: Loads the object's position and negated copies from three track tables at the current segment index, then clears a set of counters and flags. It calls one routine first.

name: clear_frame_counters_and_flags
description: Clears a fixed set of counters and status words in the object record. It is called from seven places.

name: shift_coordinates_temporarily
description: Shifts two stored coordinates by a routine result minus half of an input value, calls two routines, and then restores both original values.

name: animate_position_over_eight_steps
description: Copies eight-word blocks between tables across eight steps, then moves the position over eight further steps toward a target by fractions of the difference between table values. Each step increments a counter and some steps call routines to update the display.

name: step_position_along_segment
description: Loads the position for the current segment from track tables, offsets it, and then runs eight steps that advance the position and call routines for each step. It resets a counter first.

name: advance_frame_counter_and_draw
description: Increments a frame counter in the object record and calls several routines. An extra call is made depending on a flag bit and a stored field value.

name: clear_fields_between_calls
description: Calls a sequence of routines, clears two fields in the object record, and then calls further routines.

name: initialise_segment_and_flags
description: Sets the current segment index from a stored field, loads the start position and flags from track tables, resets timing values and status fields, and calls routines to draw. It then runs a per-frame loop that updates a frame counter and calls routines at a fixed interval.

name: start_sound_file_and_wait
description: Sets sound-related fields and a sound slot, calls routines, then polls a routine until a fixed time window passes or a status condition is met, after which it loops forever. It references the sound file path DF0 PDData Sounds3.

name: initialise_and_poll_input_loop
description: Initialises screen state and variables, waits for the vertical blank and then polls input in a loop. A tab-key value toggles a mode and resets timers, and the loop ends when a routine signals a condition. It returns minus one at the end.

name: clear_display_buffer_via_blitter
description: Calls a blitter clear wrapper, which calls the graphics library's BltClear to clear a display buffer, then calls two further routines. It returns nothing.

name: load_track_record_and_scroll
description: Loads one track record: copies its values into object fields, sets the position and its negation, and updates a scroll offset clamped to the screen. It sets four corner points for the caller. When the index reaches a fixed final value, it marks the sequence finished and returns minus one.

name: blend_position_buffers
description: Blends a stored eight-word block with a saved copy using a ratio derived from two inputs, and stores the result back into the saved copy. The ratio uses the sum of the two inputs, with ten substituted when that sum is zero.

name: next_index_with_wraparound
description: Returns the next index after the input value, wrapping back to zero once it reaches the stored count.

name: call_routine_then_return
description: Calls one routine and returns, doing no other work.

name: call_two_routines_then_return
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns without other work. It is entered through a handler pointer held in data.

name: compute_face_normal_vectors
description: Computes cross products of edge vectors for a polygon segment, dividing each component by a scalar length that defaults to one when zero, and stores the results in object normal fields. It returns the segment index it used.

name: copy_eight_words_and_reset
description: Preserves a value across a routine call, stores its negation in another field, copies an eight-word block from one table into another, and clears a status field.

name: update_frame_time_and_record
description: Computes the time since the previous frame from the shared clock and stores it. When the segment index is valid it records the interval, raises a best value when the interval is larger and above a threshold, and calls a routine to draw the result.

name: call_twice_with_swapped_pointer
description: When a flag is clear or a second flag is set, temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls a routine, then points it at a second fixed address and calls again before restoring the original value.

name: set_layout_fields_and_draw
description: Sets four layout fields in the object record to fixed values, then calls two routines.

name: draw_indicator_with_selector_table
description: When a flag combination is clear, temporarily swaps a pointer field, draws an element with arguments taken from a table indexed by a stored selector, makes two further routine calls, and restores the original pointer values.

name: call_pair_of_routines
description: Calls two routines in sequence with no other work.

name: transform_points_and_interpolate
description: Transforms a list of points using three matrix rows into three coordinate tables, then compares each point with a threshold value and computes scaled divisions to interpolate the result. Only the start of this routine is visible in the source dump.

name: insert_and_sort_object_slot
description: Inserts an object into one of several four-entry slot lists, selected from a stored value, and then bubbles the list so entries are in ascending order of a stored key. It does nothing when a flag is set.

name: shift_word_pairs_one_slot
description: Decrements a stored value by thirty-two, shifts two pairs of list words back by one slot, and calls a routine that depends on whether the low four bits of a value are zero.

name: dispatch_on_low_bits
description: Calls one of two routines depending on whether the low four bits of a value are zero.

name: select_shade_and_dispatch
description: Returns early when a flag is set or a value is negative. Otherwise it derives a shade index from a stored value, clamps it to a maximum of 127, makes several routine calls, and dispatches to one of two routines through a computed jump chosen by comparing two values.

name: draw_fixed_element_one
description: When several status flags are clear and a state field is set, temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls a routine with fixed arguments and another routine, then restores the pointer.

name: draw_fixed_element_two
description: When several status flags are clear and a state field is set, temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls a routine with a second set of fixed arguments and another routine, then restores the pointer.

name: draw_fixed_element_three
description: When several status flags are clear and a state field is set, temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls a routine with a third set of fixed arguments and another routine, then restores the pointer.

name: draw_fixed_element_four
description: When several status flags are clear and a state field is set, temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls a routine with a fourth set of fixed arguments and another routine, then restores the pointer.

name: step_channel_volume_envelope
description: Copies segment data into object and table fields, then steps a per-channel countdown that resets to eight and flips sign at its limits. The facts show it also touches the audio channel 3 volume register, and it calls one routine.

name: toggle_marker_fields
description: Sets or clears marker fields: when a flag is set it toggles three pairs of values between zero and twelve, otherwise it toggles one value at a fixed offset.

name: call_while_nonzero
description: Repeatedly calls one routine, and calls another after each nonzero result, stopping when the first routine returns zero.

name: initialise_timing_constants
description: Sets two mode fields to fixed values and writes a set of constant timing values into the object record, copying two of them into adjacent fields.

name: run_menu_input_loop
description: Initialises menu and input state, then loops reading an input code and dispatching on it. Code four returns, code three sets a state flag, and code zero steps a selection value that stays within six. It returns the code that ends the loop.

name: initialise_menu_and_run_input
description: Initialises screen and menu state and loads a view, then runs the same input dispatch loop as its neighbour. The text references include a list of credit names and the file path DF0 PDArtWork Options.

name: call_two_routines_in_turn
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns, doing no other work.

name: write_one_based_digit_field
description: Calls two routines, then either calls a third or writes a one-based number as a digit into a text field at an offset in the object record, depending on a flag. The text DF0 PDArtWork TuneUp is referenced.

name: set_option_pointers_and_draw
description: Points several object pointer fields at fixed table addresses, calls routines to draw, and makes one extra call when a field is nonzero. The text DF0 PDArtWork Options is referenced.

name: reset_menu_and_load_view
description: Clears selection and status fields, sets several layout and timing values, and calls routines, including one that loads the graphics view. It returns the previous state value.

name: run_menu_selection_loop
description: Waits until a routine returns zero, then loops on input codes. It steps several selection indices with wraparound, adjusts a slider-like value between fixed bounds, and calls routines to redraw. The text DF0 PDArtWork TuneUp is referenced.

name: run_selection_loop_with_offset
description: Starts a value at one, plus one more when the input value is odd, then loops reading input codes that step selection indices and adjust the slider-like value. It returns when a code is zero or negative, or when a status flag is set.

name: draw_selection_pointer_and_calls
description: Sets a pointer field to a fixed table address and makes several routine calls to draw the current selection.

name: compute_option_bar_layout
description: Computes bar sizes and positions from a stored value and a counter, capped at seventeen, then sets timing and layout fields. It also sets three palette-like fields according to one of three selection values.

name: initialise_and_read_menu_input
description: On its first pass, sets several state fields, copies table entries into a text buffer, and clears counters. It then reads input codes in a loop, stepping values, and returns the current selection when a code is negative or the exit code arrives.

name: sort_four_entries_descending
description: Bubble-sorts four index entries so that the values stored at a fixed field of each entry are in descending order, then stores a fixed marker in the object record.

name: write_name_and_value_rows
description: Writes four text rows, each with a nine-character name copied from a table and a three-digit value from an object field, with leading zeros replaced by blanks. The text references include THORN, STEINHAUS, NEILSEN and YOSHIWAKI.

name: initialise_and_run_list_input
description: Initialises several fields, runs a short sequence of routine calls, and then reads input codes in a loop. It steps a selection and returns the current value when a code is negative or the exit code arrives.

name: draw_row_when_index_five
description: Makes three routine calls, then makes a fourth when its input index equals five, and finishes with one more call.

name: draw_element_at_fixed_layout
description: Sets four layout fields to fixed values, calls one routine with a pointer to one fixed table address, then calls a second routine with a second fixed table address, and restores the pointer.

name: draw_value_twice_with_pointer
description: Temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address and calls a routine twice, using a stored value and fixed numbers, then makes two further routine calls and restores the pointer.

name: call_one_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns, doing no other work.

name: draw_two_digits_into_bitplanes
description: Writes a value below 100 as two decimal characters, then calls a routine and draws one eight-row glyph into the bitplanes at a column taken from its arguments.

name: draw_pair_with_swapped_pointer
description: Temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, makes two routine calls, then points it at a second fixed address for two more calls before restoring the original value.

name: forward_to_single_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns, doing no other work.

name: forward_to_another_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns, doing no other work.

name: call_three_routines_return_input
description: Calls three routines in turn and returns its input register value unchanged.

name: set_fields_and_call_pair
description: Sets four table-like fields in the object record to fixed values and four layout fields to other fixed values, then calls two routines and returns its input register value.

name: set_alternate_fields_call_pair
description: Sets four table-like fields in the object record to a second set of fixed values and four layout fields to other fixed values, then calls two routines and returns its input register value.

name: wait_for_selection_input
description: Waits for the bottom of the video frame and polls input in a loop. It clamps a pointer position to the screen, toggles a flag on the tab key, and returns a selection index when a digit or the D key is pressed. It returns a fixed sentinel value when a timeout expires.

name: return_minus_one_constant
description: Returns the constant minus one and does nothing else. It is reached only through a gap in the decoded code.

name: read_digit_and_initialise_state
description: Reads one character from a routine, converts it from an ASCII digit to a number and stores it in an object field. It then runs the same state initialisation and input loop as the menu routines.

name: call_two_then_clear_field
description: Calls two routines in sequence, then sets a status field in the object record to zero.

name: call_two_set_minus_one
description: Calls two routines in sequence, then sets a status field in the object record to minus one.

name: run_selection_loop_with_grid
description: Waits for the bottom of the video frame in a loop. It tests the pointer position against the bounds of eleven grid cells, toggles a direction flag on two key codes, and returns the selected cell index when a selection is confirmed. The graphics wait is referenced.

name: read_grid_selection_or_quit
description: Reads a key: Q or lower-case q returns minus one, and a digit from zero to eleven selects a grid cell and calls routines. Otherwise it runs the same grid hit test as its neighbour and returns the selected index.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns the constant minus one and does nothing else.

name: draw_table_entry_when_enabled
description: When an indexed flag is non-negative, temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls a routine with two values from a table, then calls another routine and restores the pointer.

name: draw_second_table_entry
description: When an indexed flag is non-negative, temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls a routine with two values from a second table, then calls another routine and restores the pointer.

name: draw_indexed_entry_when_enabled
description: When an indexed flag is non-negative, calls a routine with two values from a table indexed by the input, while a pointer field points at a fixed table address, and then restores the pointer.

name: draw_second_indexed_entry
description: When an indexed flag is non-negative, calls a routine with two values from a second table indexed by the input, while a pointer field points at a fixed table address, and then restores the pointer.

name: call_routine_countdown
description: Calls one routine once for each value from the input down to zero, then returns.

name: format_elapsed_time_digits
description: Formats the difference between the current clock and a stored start value, halved, as minutes, seconds and hundredths written as digits into a text buffer.

name: draw_pending_element_once
description: When a status flag is clear and a pending field is nonzero, clears the pending field, sets four layout fields, and calls a routine with a pointer temporarily set to a fixed table address before restoring it.

name: draw_element_with_fixed_layout
description: Sets four layout fields to fixed values, temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls two routines, and restores the pointer.

name: queue_timed_message_draw
description: When several status flags are clear, records a time from the shared clock with fixed offsets, sets a pending value and layout fields, and draws a message through routine calls with a pointer swapped to a fixed table address.

name: set_message_layout_and_draw
description: When a status flag is clear, sets four table values and four layout fields to fixed numbers, calls a routine when another field is nonzero, then makes two further routine calls.

name: render_wrapped_text_string
description: Copies a text string into a buffer and draws each character with a routine. It starts a new line at a fixed width or at a carriage return, and stores the final cursor position.

name: layout_and_render_wrapped_text
description: Sets four layout fields from stored text coordinates, then renders a string the same way as its neighbour, wrapping lines at a fixed width and storing the final cursor position.

name: render_wrapped_text_from_cursor
description: Renders a text string with line wrapping, starting from the stored cursor position, and stores the final position on exit.

name: read_line_into_buffer
description: Clears a sixteen-character buffer to spaces, then reads keyboard characters into it, converting lower case to upper case. Backspace deletes a character and carriage return finishes the line by writing a terminating zero.

name: run_timed_sequence_with_sounds
description: Returns early when a field is set. Otherwise it resets status fields, runs routine calls for fixed step counts, waits for the frame, and sets up two audio volume channels before playing a sound. It references the file paths DF0 PDArtWork First, DF0 PDArtWork PitBack and DF0 PDSounds Cheer.

name: run_timing_frame_loop
description: Sets up the frame state, then loops: each pass advances a frame counter, draws on every eighth frame, and checks a routine's result, which when zero triggers a message draw. It references the text PIT STOP.

name: continue_timing_frame_loop
description: Enters the same frame loop as its neighbour at a later point, advancing the frame counter, drawing on every eighth frame and checking a routine's result for a completion message.

name: run_key_driven_frame_loop
description: Loops once per frame, advancing a frame counter and reading a key. The L, T and P keys call routines, the Q key ends the loop with minus one when a flag allows it, and digit keys and the asterisk key set toggles and step values. It returns when the loop is finished.

name: schedule_lead_text_draw
description: When two status fields are clear, points a pointer field at a fixed table address and sets a time field to the shared clock plus thirty. The text IN LEAD is referenced.

name: schedule_lap_text_draw
description: Calls one routine, then points a pointer field at a fixed table address and sets a time field to the shared clock plus forty-five. The text LAP TIMES is referenced.

name: schedule_position_text_draw
description: When two status flags are clear, uses a fixed table value, calls routines to prepare the text, selects one of two text buffers by a flag, and sets a time field to the shared clock plus thirty. The texts POSITIONS and QUALIFYING are referenced.

name: toggle_flag_and_shift_value
description: When an indexed field is zero, toggles a flag word and then halves or doubles a stored value depending on the new flag state, clearing two fields. It then sets a pointer field and a time field to the shared clock plus thirty.

name: double_value_and_schedule_draw
description: Doubles a stored value, then sets a pointer field to a fixed table address and a time field to the shared clock plus thirty.

name: call_routine_seventeen_times
description: Calls one routine seventeen times in a row with no other work.

name: wait_for_counter_then_call
description: When a routine returns nonzero, calls another routine, busy-waits until a shared counter reaches zero, and then calls a final routine.

name: forward_to_two_routines
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: run_message_frame_loop
description: Returns early unless a flag is set. Otherwise it calls a routine and draws a message, then runs a frame loop that advances a frame counter, draws every eighth frame, and checks a routine's result for completion.

name: select_table_pairs_by_bits
description: Copies six table entries into a working table, choosing each from one of two sources according to the bits of a stored value. It calls a routine for each entry and then calls two routines through a dispatch table.

name: load_constant_shape_coordinates
description: Writes fixed coordinate values into two tables, one of five words and one of sixteen words, without making any calls.

name: draw_table_rows_then_wait
description: Sets two layout fields, draws fifteen rows from a table with a fixed horizontal position and a row index for each, then waits for a shared counter to clear before returning.

name: toggle_field_on_interval
description: When a field is nonzero, runs a 26-step loop that, every fourth step, calls a routine and negates a stored field when the routine returns zero. Two further routines are called on each step.

name: call_when_field_nonzero
description: Calls one routine only when a stored field is nonzero.

name: draw_sixteen_rows_then_wait
description: Sets two layout fields, runs a fixed step loop of routine calls, draws sixteen table rows, and waits for a shared counter to clear.

name: draw_table_rows_when_enabled
description: Draws seventeen table rows with a routine, but only while a stored field is nonzero, calling two further routines for each row.

name: play_channel_effect_sequence
description: Selects an effect by a state value from zero to seven, sets positions and offsets, and steps through the sequence calling routines that drive the period and volume registers of audio channels two and three. It then waits for a shared counter to clear.

name: call_when_flag_set_passthrough
description: Calls one routine when a stored field is nonzero, and returns its input registers unchanged in either case.

name: call_either_by_flag
description: Calls one routine if a stored field is nonzero and another routine otherwise, returning its input registers unchanged.

name: forward_call_return_inputs
description: Calls one routine and returns its input registers unchanged.

name: relay_call_return_inputs
description: Calls one routine and returns its input registers unchanged.

name: run_five_step_draw_sequence
description: Runs five steps, each swapping two pointer fields and calling routines to draw four items. It then waits for the frame and a shared counter to clear, and sets a fixed field.

name: call_pair_then_return
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: draw_two_sweeps_then_wait
description: Runs two sweeps of twenty-five steps each, calling routines to draw a row and moving a stored position by the step size on each step. It waits for a shared counter to clear between the sweeps.

name: call_with_timing_field_set
description: Sets a timing field to a fixed value, calls two routines, and then restores the field to another fixed value.

name: call_with_timing_field_alt
description: Sets the same timing field as its neighbour to a fixed value, calls two routines, and restores it.

name: call_routine_thirteen_times
description: Calls one routine thirteen times with a counter running from twelve down to zero, then returns.

name: update_two_stepped_bar_values
description: Compares two stored values, each clamped to 225 and divided by sixteen, with their previous steps. When one changes, it redraws a bar segment with routine calls, pointing a pointer field at a fixed table address during the calls.

name: draw_stepped_value_marker
description: When a flag is clear and a stored value is non-negative, stores that value shifted right by eleven and draws a marker with a routine call. The argument is the difference from another stored field, and a pointer field is set to a fixed table address during the calls.

name: draw_stepped_value_marker_delta
description: Like its neighbour, but it swaps the previously stored shifted value for the new one and draws using the difference from the old value.

name: call_when_stepped_value_nonzero
description: Calls one routine when a stored value is non-negative and its shifted value is nonzero.

name: call_pair_with_pointer_swap
description: Temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls one routine, then calls another and restores the pointer.

name: set_bounds_fields_and_draw
description: Sets one field to three and four fields to fixed bound values, then calls four routines when a flag is clear.

name: call_pair_with_fixed_pointer
description: Temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls one routine, then calls another and restores the pointer. It is the same as its neighbour.

name: set_alternate_bounds_and_draw
description: Sets one field to three and four fields to a second set of fixed bound values, then calls four routines when a flag is clear.

name: call_pair_with_table_pointer
description: Temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls one routine, then calls another and restores the pointer.

name: set_right_bounds_and_draw
description: Sets one field to three and four fields to a third set of fixed bound values, then calls four routines when a flag is clear.

name: call_pair_with_pointer_restore
description: Temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls one routine, then calls another and restores the pointer.

name: set_left_bounds_and_draw
description: Sets one field to zero and four fields to fixed bound values, then calls four routines when a flag is clear.

name: call_pair_table_pointer_restore
description: Temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls one routine, then calls another and restores the pointer.

name: set_inner_bounds_and_draw
description: Sets one field to zero and four fields to a second set of fixed bound values, then calls four routines when a flag is clear.

name: call_pair_pointer_swap_restore
description: Temporarily points a pointer field at a fixed table address, calls one routine, then calls another and restores the pointer.

name: set_far_bounds_and_draw
description: Sets one field to zero and four fields to a third set of fixed bound values, then calls four routines when a flag is clear.

name: compute_xor_offset_value
description: Stores the exclusive-or of two stored values, shifted left by two, into a fourth stored value.

name: and_combine_bitplane_blocks
description: Combines two bitplane sources with a bitwise AND across four planes of screen memory and writes the result into a destination block in each row. The source is chosen from a table indexed by a stored position, and the block is eleven words wide.

name: read_pixel_colour_index
description: Reads one pixel at a column and row from the four bitplanes of screen memory and returns a four-bit colour index built from the plane bits.

name: clear_four_bitplane_memory
description: Zeroes thirty-two thousand bytes ending at a fixed offset from the object base, writing a block of longwords on each pass. This clears all four bitplanes of the screen memory.

name: clear_bitplane_rows_from_offset
description: Clears a run of screen rows of 320 bytes each, starting at a row offset taken from a table and counting down from a stored count.

name: fill_rows_with_pattern_bits
description: Fills a block of screen rows with all zeros or all ones, chosen by a bit of a stored value. It first draws up to three bit-selected bands with routine calls, and it returns early when a flag is set and a field is zero.

name: clear_rows_nine_longwords
description: Zeroes a run of screen rows, writing nine longwords per row and counting down from a stored count.

name: fill_rows_with_ones
description: Fills a run of screen rows with ones, writing nine longwords per row and counting down from a stored count.

name: compute_row_offset_and_count
description: Stores a byte offset for the current row index at forty bytes per row, and a row count derived from that index minus a stored value minus one.

name: copy_32000_bytes_between_buffers
description: Copies thirty-two thousand bytes from a source buffer to a destination buffer in blocks of eight longwords.

name: call_blit_bitmap_routine
description: Calls the graphics library bit-block copy routine through the library jump table and returns.

name: advance_pseudorandom_seed
description: Advances a stored seed by multiplying it by a fixed constant and adding one, then returns the new value.

name: build_row_offset_table
description: Allocates a table through a routine and fills it with byte offsets forty bytes apart, one per row for a stored row count. It then stores a second routine's result in another field.

name: blend_bitplanes_with_dither
description: Blends two sets of four bitplanes into a destination by masking each byte with a dither-like bit pattern, processing 64000 bytes in an order set by a sixteen-bit pattern.

name: dispatch_if_point_in_bounds
description: Calls a routine selected by an index from a jump table, but only when the point given by its inputs lies inside a horizontal range from zero to 320 and the vertical limits stored in the object.

name: dispatch_routine_by_index
description: Calls one routine chosen from a dispatch table by an index input and returns.

name: call_pointer_for_count_range
description: Calls one routine through a stored code pointer once for each step from the first input minus the second input minus one, counting down to zero, after making one other routine call.

name: mask_four_plane_word_and
description: ANDs a sixteen-bit word in each of the four bitplanes at one screen address with a mask value, clearing the bits that are not in the mask.

name: or_plane0_and_mask_others
description: Writes a sixteen-bit word at one screen address across four bitplanes: plane zero is OR-ed with a value, and planes one to three are ANDed with a mask. This sets the plane-zero bit of a pixel column.

name: or_plane1_and_mask_others
description: Writes a sixteen-bit word at one screen address across four bitplanes: plane one is OR-ed with a value, and planes zero, two and three are ANDed with a mask. This sets the plane-one bit of a pixel column.

name: or_planes0_1_mask_rest
description: Writes a sixteen-bit word at one screen address across four bitplanes: planes zero and one are OR-ed with a value, and planes two and three are ANDed with a mask. This sets the colour bits of planes zero and one together.

name: or_plane2_and_mask_others
description: Writes a sixteen-bit word at one screen address across four bitplanes: plane two is OR-ed with a value, and planes zero, one and three are ANDed with a mask. This sets the plane-two bit of a pixel column.

name: or_planes0_2_mask_rest
description: Writes a sixteen-bit word at one screen address across four bitplanes: planes zero and two are OR-ed with a value, and planes one and three are ANDed with a mask. This sets the colour bits of planes zero and two together.

name: or_planes1_2_mask_rest
description: Writes a sixteen-bit word at one screen address across four bitplanes: planes one and two are OR-ed with a value, and planes zero and three are ANDed with a mask. This sets the colour bits of planes one and two together.

name: or_three_planes_mask_rest
description: Writes a sixteen-bit word at one screen address across four bitplanes: planes zero, one and two are OR-ed with a value, and plane three is ANDed with a mask. This sets the colour bits of the first three planes together.

name: or_plane3_and_mask_others
description: Writes a sixteen-bit word at one screen address across four bitplanes: plane three is OR-ed with a value, and planes zero to two are ANDed with a mask. This sets the plane-three bit of a pixel column.
